adjudication.rationale: In packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts, the new `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop wraps the recurring-event deletion branch. That branch builds `promises` by iterating *all* `bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(..._calendar)` and, inside that, iterates `updatedBookings` to delete each booking’s calendar ref (`updBooking.references.find(...)`). This logic does not use the outer `reference`’s `uid/externalCalendarId`, so if there are R calendar references on the booking, the recurring deletion work repeats R times, causing duplicated external delete calls and repeated `getCalendar(credential)` constructions. This is directly visible from the nesting introduced in the diff and matches the finding’s claim that the branch should be hoisted out of the per-reference loop.
